payload.blocks: Phase 3 land, and through it phases 2, 4, 5 and 6 (all depend on phase 3).
payload.headline: Widen phase 3's footprint by bin/fgos.mjs and packages/supervision/rust/observe-kinds.json?

parts.cause: The adapter stops a short-role lead with `session stop --role lead:<LANE>`, but bin/fgos.mjs's session stop only takes persona + --name matching [a-z0-9-], so that call is refused. The new wake outcome stopped-finished is missing from the fgos.supervisor.outcome vocabulary in packages/supervision/rust/observe-kinds.json. The plan named only apps/fgos/observe-kinds.json.

options.cost: One footprint commit plus one unit, about 20 minutes.
options.does: Add bin/fgos.mjs and packages/supervision/rust/observe-kinds.json to the plan and phase 3 footprint; one more unit adds the --role flag and the outcome value, then phase 3 lands.
options.gain: Acceptance 4 holds end to end: a lead with any role form is closed by the same door.
options.harm: bin/fgos.mjs is a hot shared file; another plan's footprint may hold it.
options.label: Widen the footprint by the two files

options.cost: A follow-up item and a later plan.
options.does: Land phase 3 now; the short-role stop and the vocabulary entry go to a new backlog row.
options.harm: Real wakes fail to stop short-role leads (logged, not blocking) and emit an outcome not in the vocabulary; acceptance 4 is only met in fixtures.
options.label: Land as is, open a follow-up item

parts.recommendation: Widen the footprint by the two files: the plan's outcome is one door for every role form, and both edits are small.

scope.allows: Changing the plan's footprint by exactly these two paths and editing them for the --role flag of session stop and the stopped-finished value.
scope.forbids: Any other change to bin/fgos.mjs or to other plans' footprints.

parts.what: Phase 3 is built and its tests pass on branch head-lifecycle-events/p03b: the wake door closes an idle planner of a draft/ready plan and an idle lead of a done plan through the StopSession port. Two files it needs are outside the plan footprint.
